messages:
maria: quick heads-up — I'm rolling a config-only change in the late window (23:30 UTC). Tightening tenant limits + small timeout bumps, and adding a routing hint for eu region. No model changes.
dev-deploy-bot: starting deploy job #deploy-1719504321 -> applying config patch to routing-service, qps-limiter, batcher. Staged rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 3m pauses.
anjum: can you paste the exact params? want to confirm KV cache warmup doesn't regress.
maria: sure — snippet below
```yaml
routing:
  route_hint: eu-west-1
limits:
  tenant_max_qps: 40  # from 60
  tenant_burst: 80
timeouts:
  idle_ms: 1200  # from 800
batcher:
  micro_batch_size: 4  # from 8
  packing_window_ms: 15
```
zach: lowering micro_batch_size could increase per-token latency on high-throughput tenants. We'll watch p50/p95 token latency and gpu_util.
maria: agreed. Rollout plan: deploybot will hold at 10% for 3m, check error-rate, latency, cache_pressure. If any of these exceed thresholds, auto-rollback.
ops-james: what are the thresholds? set them in the job so we don't manually intervene.
maria: set error-rate > 0.4% over 1m OR p95 latency +25% vs baseline OR cache_pressure > 0.6 -> auto-rollback.
dev-deploy-bot: thresholds applied to job #deploy-1719504321: errors>0.4%, p95_delta>25%, cache_pressure>0.6. Canary at 10% starting now.
anjum: adding a short eval job to hit common prompt sets against the canary; will post results in 6m.
sarah: updating release notes: "Config-only: tenant qps reduced, idle timeout increased, micro-batching adjusted. Purpose: reduce tail amplification and smoothing for EU routing." Link: https://redwood.docs/release/1719504321
dev-deploy-bot: canary healthy -> moving to 50% after 3m pause.
zach: seeing slight p95 uptick (~12%) on a few tenants but within threshold. gpu_util stable. No cache_pressure alerts.
anjum: evals returned no quality regressions on the prompt set. posting summary: pass 42/45 checks, two borderline latencies tied to very long context tests.
dev-deploy-bot: 50% steady -> promoting to 100%.
dev-deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: 100% applied. Job complete.
maria: thanks team. ops-james, can you keep a watch for the next 2h? I'll keep a quick revert PR ready in case we see noise.
ops-james: watching. I added a short dashboard for errors/latency/cache_pressure to the release row.
sarah: release notes live and internal changelog updated. tagging product and cs.
maria: follow-up: created revert config at https://git.internal/configs/reverts/1719504321 if needed. Ping me before executing.
zach: noted. nothing else from infra side. :thumbsup:
maria: closing thread — thanks all.
